messages:
Sam (Support): TideLabs reporting no API key in console after SSO onboarding. Alice from TideLabs says requests get 403 "api_key_missing". Anyone seen this with OIDC flows?

Kira (Onboarding): @Sam can you paste the console link and the user email? I can check the invite mapping.

Alice (TideLabs): hi, thanks. Console link: https://console.redwood.cloud/projects/tidelabs — I log in ok via Okta but under Projects I see no keys and the API returns: 

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.cloud/v1/engines/redwood-instruct-1/completions
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{
  "error": "api_key_not_found",
  "message": "No active API keys for project: tidelabs"
}
```

Raj (DevEx): that response implies the token is not linked to any project or the project_id claim is missing from OIDC token. Which IdP?

Alice (TideLabs): Okta, email alice@tidelabs.com. We used the auto-provision option during SSO enable.

Kira (Onboarding): @Alice can you confirm the SCIM group mapping? often the default org role is assigned but not project. If auto-provision didn't receive project_id claim then the user is in org but not in any project.

Sam (Support): I pulled the audit: user alice created 2026-11-15 via SSO, no project_assign event. Also the onboarding job shows: "warning: missing 'project' claim from id_token".

Lucy (SRE): cc @Raj @Kira, can you share the raw id_token (PII redacted) so I can inspect claims? If not, a token dump from the browser devtools (tokens masked) will do.

Alice (TideLabs): pasted to the thread privately. I can see claims: sub, email, name, groups but no project_id or organization_id.

Raj (DevEx): OK that's the issue. With our auto-provision we expect an OIDC claim 'redwood_project' or 'project_id'. Without it we create org membership but no project and no default API key. Quick fixes: 1) add claim in Okta mapping; 2) manually create a project in the console and provision an API key; 3) we can run a one-off provisioning script from our side if you want.

Sam (Support): Customer prefers we provision key while they update Okta. @Kira can you create project 'tidelabs' in our tenant and attach an ephemeral key with scope 'inference:invoke,embeddings:create'? Please follow security checklist.

Kira (Onboarding): on it — creating project now.

Ops Bot: deploy job started: create-project tidelabs -> success

Kira (Onboarding): Project created. Provisioned API key `rk_live_...` (redacted). Sent via secure channel to Alice. Confirmed working?

Alice (TideLabs): Verified — API now returns 200. Thanks!

Sam (Support): added notes to ticket #S-2026-147: root cause missing OIDC claim 'project_id'. Remediation: update IdP mapping to include 'redwood_project' claim, or use SCIM to include project assignment. Also documented manual provisioning fallback.

Raj (DevEx): I'll add a short KB doc with Okta claim mapping example and OIDC troubleshooting steps.

Sam (Support): closing thread after customer confirms. :white_check_mark:
